description:
The value of an agent isn’t measured by how much code it writes, but by how much software work it finishes. In this GitHub Universe 2026 session, GitHub Chief Product Officer Mario Rodriguez and Principal Engineering Manager Evan Boyle explore a new operating model where developers define outcomes and standards while GitHub Copilot agents carry work through the entire development loop. Discover how autonomous agents move beyond code generation to plan, review, secure, and deploy software while keeping people accountable for what ships. Learn how teams connect context, workflows, and enterprise controls to delegate ambitious tasks with confidence.

Speakers: 
Evan Boyle, Principal Manager, Software Engineering, GitHub 
Mario Rodriguez, Chief Product Officer, GitHub

description:
When AI-assisted security researchers proved that two unconfirmed PHP bugs could lead to arbitrary remote code execution, the FBI issued an urgent advisory warning organizations to patch or take affected servers offline. Before an official patch was deployed, leaked exploit details triggered an unprecedented race against time across the open-source ecosystem. To protect millions of servers, maintainers opened an emergency pull request on the official PHP Docker image, sparking a live watch party of over 500 comments on GitHub.

#PHP #cybersecurity #GitHub
